title: 16S rRNA sequencing of the biofilms on the anode and cathode of reactors
description: To investigate the microbial communities associated with bioelectrochemical and anaerobic digestion processes, biofilm samples were collected from the anodes and cathodes of nine single-chamber MEC-AD reactors treating landfill leachate. After 30 days of continuous operation (HRT 48 h), anode biofilms were retrieved from carbon brush electrodes and cathode biofilms from modified stainless-steel mesh electrodes. These data were used to characterize community composition, diversity, and succession in anode and cathode biofilms, and to identify putative electroactive, hydrolytic, fermentative, and aromatic-degrading microorganisms involved in DOM transformation and electron transfer in the MEC-AD system.
